title: Inpatient Care
hero.text: Comprehensive inpatient care for adults, adolescents and children, bringing together expert medical supervision, nursing care and rehabilitation within a structured clinical environment.

intro.heading: Inpatient Rehabilitation Services
text: Cambridge Hospital’s inpatient rehabilitation services provide intensive therapy, continuous nursing care and close medical oversight within a structured clinical environment. Designed for patients with complex medical and post-acute needs, our programmes bring together specialised teams, advanced therapies and round-the-clock support to restore function and accelerate recovery.
